page.title: “まだ足りない”が後ろの説明を呼ぶ

analysis.summaryJa: このページは、something・anyoneなどの不定代名詞、最上級、there構文の名詞、寸法表現など、前の語だけでは内容が十分に定まらない場合に、形容詞や形容詞句を後ろから補う仕組みを扱う。
grammarPoints: something・anything・someone・nobodyなどの不定代名詞は形容詞を後ろに置く
最上級の後ろへavailable・possibleなどを置いて範囲を補う
there構文では名詞の後ろへavailable・vacantなどの状態説明を置ける
数値＋単位＋tall・wide・long・deepで寸法を表す
補語を伴う長い形容詞句は名詞の後ろに置く
visualEvidence: 未完成の文の橋が後ろから説明ブロックを引き寄せる図が、情報不足を補う働きを示す
不定代名詞・最上級・there構文・測定値の四つのレーンが後置の代表例を整理している
数値と単位の後ろに寸法形容詞が置かれ、何の測定値かを明示している
commonTraps: useful somethingのように不定代名詞の前へ形容詞を置く
available the best optionのように最上級句の語順を崩す
寸法表現でtall・wide・longを省き、数値の意味を不明確にする
長い形容詞句を無理に名詞前へ押し込む

questions.prompt: We need ------- for the reception area that will fit beside the elevator.
questions.translationJa: エレベーター横に収まる、受付用の小型のものが必要です。
questions.explanationJa: somethingの内容を形容詞compactが後ろから説明します。

questions.prompt: Is there ------- to answer questions about the revised travel policy?
questions.translationJa: 改訂出張規程について質問に答えられる人はいますか。
questions.explanationJa: anyoneを形容詞availableが後ろから説明します。

questions.prompt: The technician found ------- during the final equipment check.
questions.translationJa: 技術者は最終機器点検で異常なものを何も見つけませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: nothingの後ろに形容詞unusualを置きます。

questions.prompt: Please bring ------- for the identity verification process.
questions.translationJa: 本人確認手続きに必要なものをすべて持参してください。
questions.explanationJa: everythingをnecessaryが後ろから限定します。

questions.prompt: The navigation system selected the shortest route ------- under the current road conditions.
questions.translationJa: ナビゲーションシステムは現在の道路状況で可能な限り最短の経路を選びました。
questions.explanationJa: 最上級the shortest routeの後ろにpossibleを置き、可能な範囲を補います。

questions.prompt: The agency offered us the lowest airfare ------- for the requested dates.
questions.translationJa: 代理店は希望日に利用できる最安の航空運賃を提示しました。
questions.explanationJa: the lowest airfareの後ろでavailableが選択可能な範囲を説明します。

questions.prompt: There are three offices ------- on the seventh floor.
questions.translationJa: 7階には空いている事務室が3室あります。
questions.explanationJa: there構文ではofficesの後ろに状態を表すvacantを置けます。

questions.prompt: The loading entrance is four meters -------, so the truck can pass through it.
questions.translationJa: 荷積み入口は幅4メートルなので、そのトラックは通れます。
questions.explanationJa: 数値＋単位の後ろにwideを置いて幅を示します。

questions.prompt: The safety briefing was nearly two hours ------- because of the additional demonstration.
questions.translationJa: 追加実演のため、安全説明会はほぼ2時間に及びました。
questions.explanationJa: two hoursの後ろにlongを置いて所要時間を明示します。

questions.prompt: There are five applicants ------- for the final interview.
questions.translationJa: 最終面接の対象となる応募者が5人います。
questions.explanationJa: eligible for the final interviewという説明がapplicantsの後ろに続きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence requesting a practical replacement.

choices.A: We need practical something before the current unit fails.
choices.B: We need something practical before the current unit fails.
choices.C: We need something practically before the current unit fails.
choices.D: We need a something practical before the current unit fails.

questions.translationJa: 現行機が故障する前に、実用的な代替品が必要です。
questions.explanationJa: somethingの後ろに形容詞practicalを置きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence asking for a knowledgeable person.

choices.A: Is familiar anyone with the billing system available today?
choices.B: Is anyone familiarity with the billing system available today?
choices.C: Is any familiar with the billing system available today?
choices.D: Is anyone familiar with the billing system available today?

questions.translationJa: 請求システムに詳しい人は今日対応できますか。
questions.explanationJa: anyoneの後ろにfamiliar with ...という長い形容詞句を置きます。
questions.focus: 不定代名詞＋長い形容詞句

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence reporting that no urgent issue was found.

choices.D: The audit revealed no urgently thing.

questions.translationJa: 監査では緊急の問題は何も明らかになりませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: nothingの後ろにurgentを置く語順が正しいです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence describing the most efficient choice.

choices.A: This is available the most efficient method.
choices.B: This is the available most efficient method.
choices.C: This is the most efficient method available.
choices.D: This is the most efficiently method available.

questions.translationJa: これは利用可能な中で最も効率的な方法です。
questions.explanationJa: 最上級名詞句の後ろにavailableを置きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about unused desks.

choices.A: There vacant are two desks beside the window.
choices.B: There are vacant beside the window two desks.
choices.C: There are two vacantly desks beside the window.
choices.D: There are two desks vacant beside the window.

questions.translationJa: 窓際に空いている机が2台あります。
questions.explanationJa: there構文でdesksの後ろに状態形容詞vacantを置けます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence giving the height of a tower.

choices.A: The communications tower is eighty meters height.
choices.B: The communications tower is eighty meters tall.
choices.C: The communications tower is tall eighty meters.
choices.D: The communications tower is eighty-meter tall.

questions.translationJa: 通信塔は高さ80メートルです。
questions.explanationJa: 数値＋複数単位＋tallの順で高さを表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence giving the length of a package.

choices.A: The package is thirty centimeters length.
choices.B: The package is long thirty centimeters.
choices.C: The package is thirty centimeters long.

questions.translationJa: その荷物は長さ30センチです。
questions.explanationJa: 述語の寸法表現はthirty centimeters longです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence identifying documents for collection.

choices.A: The documents ready for pickup are on the counter.
choices.B: The ready for pickup documents are on the counter.
choices.C: The documents readily for pickup are on the counter.
choices.D: The documents are ready for pickup on the counter are.

questions.translationJa: 受取準備のできた書類はカウンターの上にあります。
questions.explanationJa: 補語を伴うready for pickupはdocumentsの後ろに置きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence naming the fastest feasible choice.

choices.A: We chose possible the fastest delivery option.
choices.B: We chose the possible fastest delivery option possible.
choices.C: We chose the fastest possibly delivery option.
choices.D: We chose the fastest delivery option possible.

questions.translationJa: 私たちは実現可能な中で最速の配送方法を選びました。
questions.explanationJa: 最上級句の後ろにpossibleを置きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence identifying staff who can work overseas.

choices.A: There are willing to relocate abroad several employees.
choices.B: There are several employees willing to relocate abroad.
choices.C: There are several willing to relocate abroad employees.
choices.D: There are several employees willingly to relocate abroad.

questions.translationJa: 海外転勤を希望する従業員が複数います。
questions.explanationJa: willing to relocate abroadはemployeesの後ろに置く長い形容詞句です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "We need something affordable."

choices.A: We need to reduce every price immediately.
choices.B: We need something that can be sold at any price.
choices.C: We need an affordable employee to negotiate.
choices.D: We need an option that is affordable.

questions.translationJa: 私たちには手頃な価格の選択肢が必要です。
questions.explanationJa: something affordableは「手頃な何か」で、an option that is affordableと同じです。
questions.focus: 不定代名詞＋形容詞の展開

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Nobody available answered the call."

choices.A: Everyone answered the call when they became available.
choices.B: No person who was available answered the call.
choices.C: The call was answered by an unavailable number.
choices.D: Nobody called to ask about availability.

questions.translationJa: 対応可能だった人は誰も電話に出ませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: nobody availableはavailableだった人が誰もいないことを示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The kit contains everything required."

choices.A: Every kit is required to contain the same label.
choices.B: The required kit contains nothing useful.
choices.C: The kit contains all the required items.
choices.D: The kit must be returned with its receipt.

questions.translationJa: そのキットには必要な品がすべて入っています。
questions.explanationJa: everything requiredをall the required itemsへ言い換えています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "This is the safest model available."

choices.A: Of the models currently available, this one is the safest.
choices.B: This model is unavailable because it failed a safety test.
choices.C: Every available model has exactly the same safety rating.
choices.D: This is the only model that can be repaired safely.

questions.translationJa: 現在利用できるモデルの中では、これが最も安全です。
questions.explanationJa: availableが最上級の比較範囲を示しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "There are several seats empty near the stage."

choices.A: The stage has been removed to create more seats.
choices.B: Several seats near the stage are empty.
choices.C: Every seat near the stage is occupied.
choices.D: Several empty boxes are stored under the seats.

questions.translationJa: 舞台近くの座席がいくつか空いています。
questions.explanationJa: there構文のseats emptyを通常の主語＋be動詞文に直しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The machine is two meters wide."

choices.A: The machine is located two meters from the wall.
choices.B: The machine requires two meters of electrical cable.
choices.C: Two machines are installed side by side.
choices.D: The width of the machine is two meters.

questions.translationJa: その機械の幅は2メートルです。
questions.explanationJa: two meters wideは幅が2メートルという意味です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The meeting was three hours long."

choices.B: The meeting began three hours late.
choices.C: Three hours remained before the meeting.
choices.D: The meeting was held in three rooms.

questions.translationJa: 会議は3時間続きました。
questions.explanationJa: three hours longは継続時間を表し、lasted three hoursと同じです。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The applicants eligible for reimbursement received an email."

choices.A: All applicants received reimbursement without applying.
choices.B: The email explained why reimbursement had ended.
choices.C: The applicants who were eligible for reimbursement received an email.
choices.D: Only applicants who sent an email were hired.

questions.translationJa: 払戻し対象の応募者にメールが届きました。
questions.explanationJa: eligible for reimbursementという後置形容詞句を関係節へ展開しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "That was the best outcome imaginable."

choices.A: It was impossible to imagine a better outcome.
choices.B: The outcome was unexpected and unacceptable.
choices.C: Several better outcomes were already available.
choices.D: Nobody imagined that the project would finish.

questions.translationJa: それ以上の結果は想像できないほど最良でした。
questions.explanationJa: the best ... imaginableは想像できる範囲で最良という意味です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The inspector found nothing suspicious."

choices.A: The inspector suspected everyone at the facility.
choices.C: The inspector found a suspicious note and reported it.
choices.D: The inspector did not find anything suspicious.

questions.translationJa: 検査員は不審なものを何も見つけませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: nothing suspiciousをnot ... anything suspiciousに言い換えています。

questions.prompt: We are selecting a temporary project leader. We need ------- who has managed an international team before.
questions.translationJa: 臨時プロジェクト責任者を選定中です。以前に国際チームを管理した経験のある人が必要です。
questions.explanationJa: someoneの後ろにexperiencedを置きます。

questions.prompt: The equipment passed every diagnostic test. The engineer did not observe ------- during operation.
questions.translationJa: 機器はすべての診断試験に合格しました。技術者は運転中に異常なものを何も確認しませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: 否定文のanythingをunusualが後ろから説明します。

questions.prompt: The shipment leaves at noon. Please make sure ------- is ready by eleven thirty.
questions.translationJa: 貨物は正午に出発します。11時30分までに必要なものをすべて準備してください。
questions.explanationJa: everythingの内容をnecessaryが後ろから補います。

questions.prompt: Our usual branch is closed for repairs. The directory shows the nearest office ------- on Pine Street.
questions.translationJa: 通常の支店は修理のため閉鎖中です。案内には利用可能な最寄り事務所がパイン通りにあると示されています。
questions.explanationJa: the nearest officeという最上級相当の句の後ろにavailableを置きます。

questions.prompt: Demand for meeting space is low this afternoon. There are four rooms ------- after three o'clock.
questions.translationJa: 本日午後は会議室需要が低く、3時以降は4室空いています。
questions.explanationJa: there構文のroomsをvacantが後ろから説明します。

questions.prompt: The delivery truck is unusually broad. The service road must be at least six meters ------- for safe access.
questions.translationJa: 配送トラックは非常に幅広いため、安全に通るには業務道路が最低6メートルの幅を要します。
questions.explanationJa: six metersの後ろにwideを置いて道路幅を表します。

questions.prompt: The workshop includes two demonstrations and a question period. It will be ninety minutes ------- in total.
questions.translationJa: 研修には2つの実演と質疑応答が含まれ、全体で90分です。
questions.explanationJa: ninety minutes longで所要時間を表します。

questions.prompt: The archive contains hundreds of records. The files ------- for the investigation have been moved to a locked cabinet.
questions.translationJa: 保管庫には数百件の記録があります。調査に関係するファイルは施錠棚へ移されました。
questions.explanationJa: relevant for the investigationという説明がfilesの後ろに続きます。

questions.prompt: The first two proposals exceeded the budget. The committee is still seeking the best solution ------- within the cost limit.
questions.translationJa: 最初の2案は予算を超えました。委員会は費用上限内で可能な最善策をなお探しています。
questions.explanationJa: the best solutionの後ろにpossibleを置きます。

questions.prompt: The morning train is fully booked. There are no seats ------- until the 2:15 departure.
questions.translationJa: 午前の列車は満席です。午後2時15分発まで空席はありません。
questions.explanationJa: no seatsの後ろにavailableを置いて状態を補います。
